abstract: To support the high demand for ribosomes, ribosomal RNA (rRNA) is produced by hundreds of highly expressed gene copies. In this issue of Cell Genomics, Potapova et al. reveal chromosome-specific organization and heritable transcriptional activity of rRNA clusters in humans and other hominids.
